name: desk-span-1986-2005
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT={out} TMPDIR={out}/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}; mkdir -p {out}/desk {out}/tmp; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py desk; {python} research/exp/cache.py --out {cache}/desk_span_1986_2005
summarize: import json; s=json.load(open('{out}/desk/run_summary.json')); print({k: s.get(k) for k in ('best_epoch','best_val_kernel','best_val_zmse','epochs_run','n_train_cell_years','holdout_years')})
note: E024: DESK trained on 1986-2005 ONLY (2025 withheld too, after the stale label-year filter was removed); pre-registered in E024.md
